description: This file defines an interface 'ITransactionTestGrain' for Orleans grains that support transactional operations such as setting, adding, and retrieving values, as well as methods that include throwing exceptions for testing purposes.

classes.name: ITransactionTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for a transactional grain supporting set, add, get, and throw operations, extending Orleans' IGrainWithGuidKey.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets the transaction state to a new value.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds a number to the transaction state and returns the updated state.

methods.name: AddAndThrow
methods.description: Adds a number to the transaction state and then throws an exception for testing transaction rollback.

methods.name: SetAndThrow
methods.description: Sets the transaction state to a new value and then throws an exception for testing.

calls: TransactionAttribute (used as an attribute for methods)
